name: ProjectList
description: A compact project index: one row per project, the whole row a link to its case study. Narrow, a thumbnail, the title and one meta line; wide, aligned columns for project, client, discipline and period.

items.description: Projects in display order; items without href (or marked comingSoon) render as muted teaser rows.

comingSoonLabel.description: Label on teaser rows; defaults to the translated "Coming soon".

contentLanguage.description: Language of titles and clients when it differs from the page.

className.description: Additional className for the root element.

criteria.statement: A human completed an end-to-end accessibility review of this component.
criteria.note: 2026-10-17: built for the /work index list view. Reviewed: list semantics and name, one link per row with label-in-name order, aria-hidden column header, decorative thumbnails, teaser rows without links, keyboard path (Tab, Enter) via play function, :hover gated to (hover: hover) so one tap opens a row on touch screens, light and dark themes, forced colours (focus outline Highlight, teaser border CanvasText), 390px width with no horizontal overflow, axe clean in unit tests.
